rationale: Release-integrity hardening for the CLI: pulp upgrade and pulp sdk install verify SHA256SUMS before extraction in a private per-run directory, and pulp search verifies the Ed25519-signed remote package registry. The watched paths this range touches are shared CLI surfaces only (design-source-ingest: experimental/pulp-rs/src/main.rs, test/cmake/cli_import_tool_tests.cmake; design-output-and-packaging: docs/status/cli-commands.yaml): main.rs gains the --allow-unsigned-registry delegation to the C++ delegate and the private temp-dir helper for the control-broker transition; cli_import_tool_tests.cmake adds package_registry_trust.cpp to an existing test executable's source list. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves; disposition watch-only-no-authority.
